response.original_title: Omô Inã, os Filhos do Fogo
response.overview: Omô Inã, os Filhos do Fogo is a short film that respectfully and sensitively documents the daily life of a Candomblé terreiro, revealing the symbolic strength of acarajé, the meaning of the offerings and the social role of the terreiro among the poor communities in its surroundings. The soundtrack is composed from real babalorixá songs, carefully reprocessed to create a mystical and immersive sound environment.
response.title: Omô Inã, os Filhos do Fogo
